title: Mr
staffNotes: Skilled Worker dependant — partner Aparna. Demo case from Resources checklist.

slots.instructions:
Upload a clear scan or photo of the passport identity page (and any pages requested in your checklist).

Ensure all four edges are visible, on a plain background, with no glare or shadow. Every word and the photo must be readable.

Please complete and sign the **first page** of the attached document. Kindly ensure that all required fields are completed, including your **full name, address, postcode, date, and signature**. Once completed, upload the signed document here with your other documents.

Download the blank Home Office consent form using the button below if you have not already received it.
Your adviser will prepare the covering letter for this application. You do not need to upload a file for this item.

Upload a clear scan or photo of the passport identity page (and any pages requested in your checklist).

Ensure all four edges are visible, on a plain background, with no glare or shadow. Every word and the photo must be readable.

Upload your Certificate of Sponsorship (CoS) reference document, or the letter from your employer confirming that the CoS has been issued if the CoS is still pending.

If your CoS is pending, a short text file or employer letter explaining the status is acceptable — your adviser will confirm.

Upload a clear copy of your marriage or civil partnership certificate.

All text must be readable and all four edges of the document visible.

Upload a screenshot of your eVisa (or digital status) from your UKVI account.

The **visa start date** and **visa expiry date** must both be clearly visible. A screenshot is sufficient.

If either date is missing or unreadable, the upload does not prove your leave — please retake the screenshot.

Generate a new share code on GOV.UK and upload a screenshot or PDF showing the full code.

When asked what you need the code for, select **“To prove an immigration matter”** — this is the option to **prove immigration status** for something else. Do **not** select “right to rent” or “right to work”.

The code should have at least **one month** of validity remaining. If you cannot generate a valid code, contact your adviser before uploading.
donts: Selecting "right to rent" or "right to work" instead of immigration matter
